discussion.body: Act 1 storyboard. Locations: Meddos, Timshaw, Breskshire court, Iron's Gate. Joins: Rook (FEAT-029), Halric (FEAT-035). Liraen (FEAT-028) is already contracted to sing at the Gate and meets Cael on the road; she is a main, not a recruit option. Ysolde (FEAT-034) may appear as a guest healer and leave. Beats: human court pageant over a food levy for Constium; Rook lifts a sealed Gate writ; Halric is the Gate knight who should have arrested them and instead walks with them; first clear sightline to the World Cannon; a Gate captain dies of heat with no fire. Death crisis: Halric can die covering Cael in the heat-death scene; default is he lives. Contingency: an unnamed captain takes Gate command. Temple not yet entered. Frames: market, court, Gate wall, Cannon horizon, heat death.
